name: arome3/evidence-based-brand-systems
description: A brand system skill that builds and verifies brand assets from evidence rather than guesswork: brand tokens, boards, assets, and source references, checked by a local brand verifier script. The workflow emphasizes verifying brand claims against captured references before shipping brand output.
install: /plugin install evidence-based-brand-systems@evidence-based-brand-systems, plus a skill-installer path for the skill folder. README also lists pip installs for the verifier's own dependencies (fonttools, uharfbuzz, playwright, pillow) and a Playwright browser install step; those are dependency installs for the local verifier, not a pipe installer, and the plugin route is presented first.
